text:
Samir Patel: CI on main is red — deploy-to-staging job failing with Azure auth error.
ci-bot: [deploy.yml] job deploy-to-staging failed • <https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/runs/12345>
Samir Patel: log excerpt:
```
Requesting token from Azure AD...
ERROR: AADSTS700082: The provided grant has expired.
status=401 body={"error":"invalid_grant"}
``` 
Leah Kim: hmm, did we rotate the service principal creds yesterday? :eyes:
Evan Zhou: I rotated a key for the sp-ops principal but I didn't touch federated creds. Could be a terraform apply that removed the federated-credential.
Jun Park: I can check. Running:
```
az ad app federated-credential list --id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
``` 
Jun Park: also verifying if Vault has fallback creds: `vault kv get -field=client_secret secret/ci/azure-sp`
Samir Patel: if federated credential is gone we should re-create it and then rerun. Anyone with perms to run TF apply?
Leah Kim: I can trigger a manual rerun once Jun confirms fix. @Evan can you hold off deleting the key?
Evan Zhou: yep paused. Jun — need a quick workaround in the meantime?
Jun Park: temporary workaround: create a short-lived client secret in Azure portal and push to Vault, then CI will pick it up. I'll avoid long-lived tokens. Will post steps.
Jun Park: creating secret now, will push to `secret/ci/azure-sp/temp` and mark TTL 6h.
ops-bot: vault: secret/ci/azure-sp/temp created by Jun Park (ttl=6h)
Leah Kim: ok initiating rerun: `gh workflow run deploy.yml --ref main`
ci-bot: workflow dispatch requested — <https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/runs/12346>
ci-bot: deploy-to-staging job started
ci-bot: deploy-to-staging job succeeded ✅
Samir Patel: nice. Jun please follow up with a PR to re-add federated credential via TF and an incident note.
Jun Park: will open PR + issue: infra#321. Also adding an alert to detect missing federated credentials.
Leah Kim: thanks all :pray:
